_readme: Taste markers per shelf book: marker id -> strength (1 minor, 2 clear, 3 central), in the vocabulary of book-markers.json. Written by tools/taste.py merge from agent output following tools/taste-prompt.md. Ids as in book-profiles.jsonl.
_vd: Digest of the marker ids when the book was marked; an older vd still counts, but `status` reports it because the book never had the chance to use a marker added since.
